oneOf.description: Answer to the host's hello.

Every event of the session up to and including `after_seq` is durable on the vault.
Cumulative: a later ack covers every earlier one.
A batch was refused and changed nothing; `cursor` is the last seq the vault holds.

cursor.description: The session and the last seq the vault holds of it.

oneOf.description: The connection failed, such as a bad hello or a malformed frame; the vault closes it.
The secrets in the sets granted to this host, answering [`HostMessage::ListSecrets`].

secrets.description: The secrets, without values, ordered by set, then name.

oneOf.description:
Every secret a [`HostMessage::FetchSecrets`] or [`HostMessage::FetchHostSecrets`] asked
for, with its value.

secrets.description: One per secret asked for, in the order asked.

oneOf.description:
A [`HostMessage::FetchSecrets`] or [`HostMessage::FetchHostSecrets`] was refused and
handed nothing out.

Every provider login of the vault's CLIProxyAPI, ordered by provider, then label; sent
right after the hello and whenever one changes, only to a host the vault told where the
proxy is (`VaultHello.cliproxyapi`). Each is an account on the host, run through the
proxy pinned to it; one not listed any more is no longer an account.

Cursor.description: A position in a session's journal.

after_seq.description: Last event seq the client holds; 0 for none.

FetchedSecret.description: A secret's value, as the vault hands it to a host.

secret.description: The secret, as the fetch named it.

Provider.description: Vendor CLI that runs a session. Open set: accept names not listed in `examples`.

ProviderLogin.description: A provider login a vault's CLIProxyAPI holds, without its tokens.

email.description: The email it is signed in as, when the proxy knows it.

fallback.description:
Whether it is fallback-only, as `Account.fallback` is: hosts and the proxy's own pool
pick it only while every other login of its provider is unavailable.

label.description: The owner's name for it; else its email, or the proxy's label for it when it has none.

message.description: What the proxy says about it, such as why it is cooling down or failing.

name.description: The proxy's name for it, the file it is kept in; for `remove_provider_login`.

pin.description:
What a host puts before a model name, `<pin>/<model>`, for the proxy to run the request
on this login only.

provider.description: The provider it signs in to.

state.description: Whether the proxy can use it now.

until.description: When a login in `cooling_down` is tried again, as far as the proxy knows.

usage.description:
Every limit window it last reported, from the provider's answers to requests the proxy
made with it; empty until it made one.

ProviderLoginState.description: Whether a vault's CLIProxyAPI can use a provider login now.

oneOf.description: In use.
Out of quota or rate-limited, until `until`.
The provider no longer takes it: sign in again, or remove it.
Failing for another reason, which `message` gives.
Turned off on the proxy.

RejectReason.description: Why the vault refused a batch.

oneOf.description: The batch starts after the seq following the vault's cursor; re-send from that seq.

The batch holds an event at a seq the vault already has, and it differs from what the
vault has. The host's journal diverged from what it replicated earlier; stop
replicating the session until someone resolves it.

ReplicationError.description: A connection-level failure reported to the host.

oneOf.description: The message was malformed or invalid, or came before the hello.
The device is not paired, or the hello names a host it was not paired as.
The vault failed.

SecretError.description: Why secrets could not be handed out; nothing was.

candidates.description: For `ambiguous`, every `set/NAME` the secret could be, ordered.

secret.description: The secret it is about, as named; absent when it is about none in particular.

SecretErrorCode.description: Kind of failure handing secrets out.

oneOf.description: A bare `NAME` is in more than one set granted to the host; name it as `set/NAME`.
No set granted to the host has the secret, or the named set has no such secret.
The named set exists but is not granted to the host.
The host is not linked to a vault, so it has no secrets.
The host is linked to a vault but cannot reach it now.

description.description: What it is for, on one line.

updated_at.description: When its value was last set.

SecretRef.description: A secret as a host's session names it: `NAME`, or `set/NAME` when more than one set granted to the host has `NAME`.

SecretValue.description:
A secret's value. Its `Debug` never shows it, so logging a message that carries one leaks
nothing; read it with [`Self::expose`].

SessionId.description: Identifies a session; a ULID string, opaque to receivers.

UsageWindow.description: Usage of one provider limit window, such as a five-hour or weekly limit.

resets_at.description: When the window resets; absent when the provider does not say.

used_percent.description: Share of the window's limit used, from 0 to 100.

window.description: Window name, in the provider's own naming.

VaultHello.description: The vault's answer to a host's hello.

acked.description:
For every session of this host the vault holds, the last seq it holds durably. A session
not listed has nothing on the vault yet. The host resumes each session right after its
cursor here. Empty when the replication versions differ.

A cursor beyond the host's own latest seq means the host lost events the vault holds,
such as after restoring an older backup; its next events at those seqs would conflict,
so the host does not replicate that session until someone resolves it.

build.description: Build name and version, for logs, e.g. `herder/0.1.0`.

cliproxyapi.description:
Where this host reaches the vault's CLIProxyAPI, such as `https://cpa.example.com:8317`;
sent only when the vault runs one and holds this host's client key, the secret
`CLIPROXYAPI_KEY` granted to the host for its own use. An endpoint account
with this `endpoint` and that `key_secret` runs on the vault's provider logins.

replication_version.description: The vault's [`REPLICATION_VERSION`]; on a mismatch both sides disconnect.
